Stereo Dataset
	


	
		
	
	
		Dataset Summary
	

StereoDataset is a synthetic multiview stereo dataset rendered in Unreal Engine.
Each scene combines a map, a character mesh, an animation clip, a validated
spawn location, and a camera trajectory. The released scene folders contain
synchronized per-camera RGB videos (cam_XX_rgb.mp4), per-camera depth videos
(cam_XX_depth.mkv), and scene-level metadata including _scene_complete.json,
trajectory.json, and baseline.json.
